title: RPG Maker MZ : Enemy become Ally(Zombie virus)

posts.author: am1a
posts.body: I want to make a zombie game. the player become zombie, ate the people when they run away, and after the people die, they becomes our ally kill other people on the map. anybody know what plugin i need for this?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
for that function alone?
none
make an attack skill that targets allies, then give all enemies an attack pattern that has the regular skills on rank 6 or lower and the zombie attack on rank 9 but conditioned on the zombie state.
then as soon as the enemies get the zombie state they will attack their own side (unfortunately including the zombies, but you can minimize that by reducing the target rate for zombies)
